snippet.title: Lady Death Demonicron - The Official Release Trailer - Get it on digital Aug 31 - Physical Nov 2026
snippet.description:
Lady Death Demonicron is an all new side-scrolling, sword-slicing, magic-wielding, 15 level co-op hack and slash that takes the best aspects of the 1990s arcade classics all mixed together with a killer industrial-metal soundtrack.

Pre-order exclusive digital and physical packs here:
https://artofplayshop.com/collections/lady-death

Listen to the killer track 'Angel Of Death' or check out Demon Pu##y in the links below:
